message.content: {"caption":"Three-panel schematic comparing memory-update strategies for test-time scaling: independent trajectory memories, parallel trajectory selection, and sequential refinement.","description":"The diagram shows (a) vanilla TTS, where existing memory items are used to produce trajectories and new memories for a subsequent task; (b) parallel MaTTS, where current memory informs several trajectories that are compared through self-contrast before producing new memory; and (c) sequential MaTTS, where a trajectory is iteratively refined and the intermediate reasoning is used to update memory. Each panel depicts a transition from task q_i to task q_{i+1}.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
